# Introduction

This experiments aims at understanding the impact of a chronic oral exposure to imidacloprid on the ultrastructure of synaptic boutons in the MB lip.

Bees were reared in cages for 7 days with access to sucrose solution (50% w/w) supplemented or not with Imidacloprid (5ng/g).
Bees were dissected after emergence (1-day-old), or three days after the end of imidacloprid treatment (5ng/g) (10-day-old). Their brains were immunostained for synapsin and imaged using a confocal STED microscope.
The quantification of synaptic boutons and synapsin-positive units (SPUs) was performed using MATLAB and the parameters identified by Nicola by comparing with manual counting in all treatment groups (NB, CTL, IMI5).


**Independent variables:**
Group: C, I, NB

**Dependent variables:**
MG.Density: synaptic bouton density; continuous variable.
MG.Volume: synaptic bouton volume; continuous variable.
SPU.Density: synapsin-positive units density; continuous variable.
SPU.Volume: synapsin-positive units volume; continuous variable.

# Set up

Load packages
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)
library(gridExtra)
library(cowplot)
library(lsmeans)
library(car)
library(sandwich)
library(emmeans)
library(rstatix)
```


Load datasets and add important variables

```{r datasets}
rm(list = ls())
data<-read.csv('Results_sted10.csv',header=T,sep=';')

data$Sample<-as.factor(data$Sample)
lev<-levels(data$Sample)

# For each sample, average values from the two ROIs (hires 1, hires 2)
data2<-cbind(lev, rep(NA,21))
data2<-as.data.frame(data2)
colnames(data2)<-c('Sample','MG.Density')
for (i in lev){
  data2$MG.density[data2$Sample==i]<-mean(c(data$MG.density[data$Sample==i & data$hires==1], data$MG.density[data$Sample==i & data$hires==2]))
  data2$MG.Volume[data2$Sample==i]<-mean(c(data$MG.Volume[data$Sample==i & data$hires==1], data$MG.Volume[data$Sample==i & data$hires==2]))
  data2$SPU.density[data2$Sample==i]<-mean(c(data$SPU.density[data$Sample==i & data$hires==1], data$SPU.density[data$Sample==i & data$hires==2]))
  data2$SPU.Volume[data2$Sample==i]<-mean(c(data$SPU.Volume[data$Sample==i & data$hires==1], data$SPU.Volume[data$Sample==i & data$hires==2]))
  data2$Group[data2$Sample==i]<-data$Group[data$Sample==i]
}
data<-data2[,-2]

lev.ord.group <- c("NB", "C", "I")
```

# Look at data distribution

## Diagnostic plots

On raw data
```{r diagnostic, echo=FALSE}
model<-lm(data$MG.density~data$Group)
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
plot(model, main='MG Density')
model<-lm(data$MG.Volume~data$Group)
plot(model, main='MG Volume')
model<-lm(data$SPU.density~data$Group)
plot(model, main='SPU Density')
model<-lm(data$SPU.Volume~data$Group)
plot(model, main='SPU Volume')
```
## Normality of residuals 
Tested with a Shapiro test
- According to Group
```{r normality, echo=FALSE}
m1 <- aov(data$MG.density ~ data$Group) 
m2<- aov(data$MG.Volume ~ data$Group)
m3<- aov(data$SPU.density ~ data$Group)
m4<- aov(data$SPU.Volume ~ data$Group)
test1<-shapiro.test(residuals(m1))
test2<-shapiro.test(residuals(m2))
test3<-shapiro.test(residuals(m3))
test4<-shapiro.test(residuals(m4))
results<-matrix(c(test1[["p.value"]],test2[["p.value"]],test3[["p.value"]],test4[["p.value"]]), ncol=1)
colnames(results)<-"p-value"
rownames(results)<-c("MG.Density","MG.Volume", "SPU.Density","SPU.Volume")
as.table(results)

```
## Homoscedasticity 
tested with a Bartlett test
- According to Group
```{r homoscedasticity, echo=FALSE}
bartlett.test(data$MG.density,data$Group)
bartlett.test(data$MG.Volume,data$Group)
bartlett.test(data$SPU.density,data$Group)
bartlett.test(data$SPU.Volume,data$Group)
```
# Statistical Analyses

Data were analyzed in R. For all dependent variables, preliminary diagnostic plots (Residuals vs. Fitted and Q-Q plots) revealed presence of outliers and heteroscedasticity. To ensure statistical validity without the exclusion of data points, a unified robust modeling framework was employed.

For two-photon and STED images (One-Way designs), a Welch’s ANOVA (oneway.test) was used to account for unequal variances. Post-hoc comparisons were conducted using the Games-Howell test, which is the robust equivalent to Tukey’s HSD for heteroscedastic data. In all analyses, p-values were adjusted for multiple comparisons using the Tukey method to control for the family-wise error rate. Statistical significance was defined at p = 0.05.

## MG density
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#data<-data_no24 #for sted10
# The Welch's ANOVA
welch_model <- oneway.test(MG.density ~ Group, data, var.equal = FALSE)
print(welch_model)

# Post-hoc 
posthoc <- games_howell_test(data, MG.density ~ Group)
print(posthoc)
```

## MG Volume 
(MG.Volume is averaged per individual)
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# The Welch's ANOVA
welch_model <- oneway.test(MG.Volume ~ Group, data, var.equal = FALSE)
print(welch_model)

# Post-hoc 
posthoc <- games_howell_test(data, MG.Volume ~ Group)
print(posthoc)
```

## SPU density
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# The Welch's ANOVA
welch_model <- oneway.test(SPU.density ~ Group, data, var.equal = FALSE)
print(welch_model)

# Post-hoc 
posthoc <- games_howell_test(data, SPU.density ~ Group)
print(posthoc)
```

## SPU volume
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# The Welch's ANOVA
welch_model <- oneway.test(SPU.Volume ~ Group, data, var.equal = FALSE)
print(welch_model)

# Post-hoc 
posthoc <- games_howell_test(data, SPU.Volume ~ Group)
print(posthoc)
```

*Conclusions for 10-day-old bees: * No significant differences between groups on MG density (Welch ANOVA: F = 1.21, p = 0.32) and MG volume (F = 0.02, p = 0.98). Significant differences were found on SPU density (F = 7.14, p < 0.005) and SPU volume (F = 3.31 p = 0.055). SPU density of control and imi-treated is significatively different from newborns (p < 0.05). SPU volume of imi-treated is significatively different from newborns (p < 0.05).


# Graphical representations

```{r, echo=FALSE}
data_summary <- function(data, varname, groupnames){
  require(plyr)
  summary_func <- function(x, col){
    c(mean = mean(x[[col]], na.rm=TRUE),
      sd = sd(x[[col]], na.rm=TRUE))
  }
  data_sum<-ddply(data, groupnames, .fun=summary_func,
                  varname)
  data_sum <- rename(data_sum, c("mean" = varname))
 return(data_sum)
}

data.sum<-data_summary(data, 'MG.density', 'Group')

p1<-ggplot(data.sum, aes(factor(Group,lev.ord.group), MG.density)) +  
  geom_bar(aes(fill=factor(Group,lev.ord.group)), stat='identity', width=0.6, col="black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("gold2", "darkorange2","blue")) + 
  ylab('MG density [#/µm^3]') +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank( ), legend.position = 'none', panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,0.12))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=MG.density-sd, ymax=MG.density+sd), width=0.2)

data.sum<-data_summary(data, 'MG.Volume', 'Group')

p2<-ggplot(data.sum, aes(factor(Group,lev.ord.group), MG.Volume)) +  
  geom_bar(aes(fill=factor(Group,lev.ord.group)), stat='identity', width=0.6, col="black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("gold2", "darkorange2","blue")) + 
  ylab('MG Volume [µm^3]') +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank( ), legend.position = 'none', panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,1.5))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=MG.Volume-sd, ymax=MG.Volume+sd), width=0.2)

data.sum<-data_summary(data, 'SPU.density', 'Group')

p3<-ggplot(data.sum, aes(factor(Group,lev.ord.group), SPU.density)) +  
  geom_bar(aes(fill=factor(Group,lev.ord.group)), stat='identity', width=0.6, col="black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("gold2", "darkorange2","blue")) + 
  ylab('SPU density[#/µm^3]') +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank( ), legend.position = 'none', panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,60))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=SPU.density-sd, ymax=SPU.density+sd), width=0.2)+
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("NB","C")), tip_length=0.1, y_position=c(52), annotations = '', col='black') +
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("NB","I")), tip_length=0.1, y_position=c(56), annotations = '*', col='black') 

data.sum<-data_summary(data, 'SPU.Volume', 'Group')

p4<-ggplot(data.sum, aes(factor(Group,lev.ord.group), SPU.Volume)) +  
  geom_bar(aes(fill=factor(Group,lev.ord.group)), stat='identity', width=0.6, col="black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("gold2", "darkorange2","blue")) + 
  ylab('SPU Volume [µm^3]') +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank( ), legend.position = 'none', panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,0.01))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=SPU.Volume-sd, ymax=SPU.Volume+sd), width=0.2)+
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("NB","I")), tip_length=0.1, y_position=c(0.008), annotations = '*', col='black') 

pFig4DEF <- cowplot::plot_grid(p1,p2,p3,p4, ncol = 2, labels = c('A', 'B', 'C', 'D'), rel_widths = c(7,7,7,3))
pFig4DEF
```

# Correlation between dependent variables

## Within each dataset and group
```{r, echo=FALSE}

# diagnostic of ditribution
m1<-lm(SPU.density~MG.density*Group, data)
plot(m1, which = 3)
shapiro.test(residuals(m1))
boxplot(residuals(m1) ~ data$Group)
leveneTest(residuals(m1) ~ Group, data)

Anova(m1) #non significant interaction for sted-7 (p = 0.07) and sted-10 (p = 0.5188)
m2<-lm(SPU.density~MG.density+Group, data)
anova(m1,m2)
Anova(m2) 
emmeans(m2, pairwise ~ Group)


pCorr1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = MG.density, y = SPU.density, color = Group))+
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.6)+
  geom_smooth(method = lm, aes(fill = Group), se=T, alpha = 0.1)+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank( ), legend.position = 'right')+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("NB" = "#999999", "control" = "#0072B2", "treated" = "#D55E00")) 
pCorr1

#ggsave("correlation_Sted7_R.pdf",pCorr1, width = 17.8, height = 10, units="cm", dpi=300)

```
Sted-10: No effect of MG density on SPU density (p > 0.05). Effect of group (F = 3.8771, p < 0.05). Posthoc: Imi-treated different from newborn (p < 0.05)
